summary: Publish a verbatim source-content restyle with geometry-defective slides flagged when strict source readback is complete, without re-authoring those slides.
invariants: Per-slide source and repair admission remains strict.
A verbatim deck with complete browser source readback may publish geometry-defective slides flagged instead of failing the whole deck.
Flag-only publication does not re-author terminal source-reflow slides.
forbidden: Publish when source text is missing, changed, or reordered.
Use flagged publication to bypass strict whole-deck source readback.
